headline: Shenandoah Telecommunications Declares 2026 Annual Dividend
summary: The Board of Directors of Shenandoah Telecommunications Company declared a cash dividend of $0.12 per share.
why: Dividend announcements provide income-focused investors with insights into a telecommunications company's cash flow stability and capital return policies.
